description: Hoplite is a turn-based strategy game focusing on tactical movement around small maps. Challenging gameplay Hoplite aims to make you think before you act. Every move counts! Make strategical choices to upgrade your abilities. Procedurally generated levels give a new experience every play. Leaderboard and achievements through Google Play (optional) Premium A one time purchase, granting additional features. Venture deeper, earn achievements, unlock additional choices and access challenge mode.
